purpose: Development-only test of whether different private task histories create measurable scoped capability differences under the same qwen3.8-max backbone.

backbone.transport: Mac AppWorld -> project SSE-to-JSON adapter -> existing local router

pre_exposure_dynamic_range_gate.reuse_if_usable: These exact runs become the none-condition rows of the later exposure matrix; they are not rerun selectively.
pre_exposure_dynamic_range_gate.ceiling_rule: If all 3 tasks achieve official success, stop this qwen3.8-max exposure experiment before donor acquisition and version a new backbone contract.
pre_exposure_dynamic_range_gate.floor_rule: If all 3 tasks fail, mean official passed-test fraction is <= 0.30, and none issues complete_task, stop before donor acquisition and version a new backbone contract.
pre_exposure_dynamic_range_gate.usable_rule: Otherwise the target has sufficient development headroom and donor acquisition proceeds.

C_common_temporal.role: common temporal/contact scaffold held fixed across A/B treatment contrasts

acquisition_protocol.worker_initialization: Each condition is an independent clone with the same model, prompt, tools, and empty private state.
acquisition_protocol.private_provenance: Each non-none worker executes its own assigned train tasks; no realized trace or memory is copied from another condition.
acquisition_protocol.memory_during_acquisition: disabled; all assigned exposure tasks use the common base policy so acquisition-task performance is not recursively changed by earlier consolidated memory.
acquisition_protocol.world_reset: fresh independent AppWorld world for every acquisition task
acquisition_protocol.promotion_source: worker-own environment_io trace and public runtime execution status only
acquisition_protocol.promotion_support_rule: An interface enters a donor-role memory only if that worker executes it successfully in both 2/2 acquisition tasks for that donor family.
acquisition_protocol.failed_support_behavior: Do not manually add or repair a missing interface; record the missing support and continue with only earned evidence.

target_probe_protocol.none_rows: reuse pre-exposure dynamic-range runs if the gate is usable
target_probe_protocol.prompt_change: Only the frozen private-experience section differs across conditions; base AppWorld prompt and model/runtime settings stay fixed.

behavioral_secondary: invalid or invented API call count
primary_measurements.slot_audit_boundary: Evaluator-private values are used only offline after execution; never inserted into prompts, memories, binders, or action selection.

development_capability_difference_gate.rule: At least one of phone_text_effect, payment_effect, or combined_effect must improve a predeclared content endpoint on at least 2 of 3 paired target siblings, with non-negative mean direction for that contrast.
development_capability_difference_gate.efficiency_only: Efficiency/token/API-call improvements without a content-endpoint improvement are recorded as procedural-efficiency evidence but do not satisfy the capability-difference gate.
development_capability_difference_gate.statistical_scope: n=3 sibling tasks is development feasibility only; no confirmatory significance claim is made.

boundaries: No test_normal or test_challenge task is used for development selection.
No target evaluator result may change prompt text, memory extraction, donor whitelist, treatment conditions, condition order, or promotion threshold.
No evaluator-private truth may enter acquisition memory or execution policy.
No worker may receive another worker's realized trace or memory.
All target conditions use the same qwen3.8-max model route and runtime settings.
If the pre-exposure gate declares ceiling or floor, stop before donor acquisition rather than manufacturing headroom by changing step budgets or prompts.
